target_customer: Large water-dependent corporations (beverage, consumer goods, mining)
problem: Companies lack site level water risk data to measure, report and mitigate water exposure.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS with implementation and advisory support

founders.name: Nicolas Wertheimer
founders.background_notes: Medical doctor per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combines satellite and hydrology data with company operations data.

defensibility.rationale: Enterprise integrations and data pipelines; competitors include ESG platforms.

market_need_then: Corporate buyers faced rising water scarcity and disclosure expectations in 2021, and the company's launch pitch cited customers such as Coca-Cola, Diageo, Colgate and AB InBev needing a financial view of site level water risk.

branding.community_and_virality: Celebrity angels listed in coverage; no merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name, little evidence of brand driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Waterplan raised a $7M seed in April 2022 and an $11M Series A in May 2023 led by Base10, selling to large beverage and consumer goods companies. Founders had water and software backgrounds. It has expanded into carbon and AI metering and no exit or shutdown has been reported.
notes: Totals vary by source ($18.5M announced, $28.67M CB Insights, $44M Dealroom); later rounds not verified. Competitor lists on aggregators (Ecolab, Xylem, Workiva) undated; none recorded. yespress lists more co-founders (Comercio, Cesio) not on YC page.
